firstMaterialDivergence: adapter.ts applies mutations from every event in the stream, rather than selecting and materializing only the numerically greatest complete valid epoch.

evidenceAssessments.reason: The authoritative contract identifies epoch as the field that scopes delta state.
The authoritative contract identifies sequence as the ordering field required to validate and apply an epoch.
The authoritative contract identifies BEGIN as the epoch-start marker.
The authoritative contract identifies COMMIT as the epoch-completion marker.
The authoritative contract requires key-ascending output order.

preservedInvariants: State from different epochs is never combined
Only one complete valid epoch is materialized
Deletes and later key reuse are interpreted inside the selected epoch
summary: The authoritative, timely delta-stream contract and supplied policy establish a reproducible adapter defect: current materialization leaks mutations across epochs and does not reject streams without a complete valid epoch. Repair is bounded to adapter.ts.
